newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican police hold eight in burning death of man.
newsitem.headline: Mexican police hold eight in burning death of man.

text.p: Mexican police were holding eight people in connection with the burning death of a man who was lynched for allegedly raping and killing a young woman, the state government of Veracruz said on Thursday.
Mexicans were shocked by images broadcast on Wednesday showing a man in his late 20s being burned alive before a large crowd of people, including women and children.
The man had allegedly raped and killed a young woman in the town of Playa Vicente in the southern state of Veracruz.
After being badly beaten and tied to a tree, the townspeople poured gasoline over the man, then set him on fire. The onlookers stood in shock or smiled as flames engulfed the man.
